Banco Symbols 1: the not-equal sign (U+2260) for the lesson page, normal and bold weight.
Derived from the "=" of KaTeX_Main (katex@0.19.0/fonts) plus a drawn slash; built by bin/build-symbols-font.
Atkinson Hyperlegible, the lesson font, has no U+2260, and a student's system may have no fallback for it.
KaTeX's license (katex@0.19.0/LICENSE) applies to the glyph outlines it takes from KaTeX_Main.
